verdict.rationale: Otter documents an enterprise opt-out from AI model training ('Keep your organization's data out of AI model training. Contact your account manager') and offers audit logs/SSO (otter-docs-19, otter-docs-20), but there is no SOC 2 or HIPAA certification documentation in the evidence, and community reports (otter-comm-6) note Otter's own privacy statement says anonymized recordings are used for training by default, suggesting the opt-out is a manual, sales-mediated exception rather than a self-service enforceable admin control. missing for 10: SOC 2/HIPAA compliance documentation, self-service enforceable opt-out toggle, independent confirmation the opt-out is honored.
